title: #kokandyproductions does it again! #americanpsychothemusical slays.
transcript: I have been waiting to see a production of “American Psycho The Musical” ever since I got wind of it from the misunderstood Broadway production in 2016 and thankfully Kokandy Productions in Chicago stepped up at the challenge — and this production exceeded all my expectations. The moment you enter Chopin Theatre's basement venue through the clear plastic curtains you're walking into Patrick Bateman's tormented mind and strap yourself in… Now if you're unfamiliar with the material American Psycho The Musical is a masterpiece Duncan Sheik’s Depeche Mode/ Pet Shop Boys-inspired score fits the material like an Armani suit. Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa’s adaptation sharpens the satire of white male fragility, excess and isolation and it's wickedly funny. under Derek Van Barham's direction this production is sleek, gritty, clever, resourceful, unexpected, taut. The cast with Kyle Patrick in the lead is just firing on all cylinders. Heidi Joosten’s music direction is crisp AF. It runs through November 26. go see it just go see it
